1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One worker, broad contact rings and slow drive changes. Track three different live contacts with generous actuator response. Collect each moving output passport within its 3-second trip to the exit line.
1.natural_language: Lift the labeled drive housings to discover concealed tray and seal motion before deployment. Opened housings stay visible. Bench inspection safely previews only the startup segment; later drive pairs appear during the stepped relay. Record a sweep from CATCH to PASS. Deploy your recorded workers and correct their hand heights as trays and seal heads advance one fixed 60 ms logical slice per completed lever action or successful passport pickup. Click each moving passport at OUT before it crosses the exit line. Clear all three passports. Waiting leaves the relay stable. A missed catch, seal, pass or pickup, or an uncollected departing passport, ends the episode. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
